answer: Bind each agent to one carrier-signed eSIM identity. To register, the agent shows its eSIM serial and the carrier signs proof it passed its identity check. The chain stores only a hash of the serial, blocks a second registration from the same eSIM, and lets peers ask the carrier to re-confirm suspects. A sybil farm then needs a fresh SIM and identity check per clone, about fifteen dollars and one real ID each, so a thousand fakes costs fifteen thousand dollars. Like a velvet rope it is smooth for a real guest and useless for a fable about a crowd that never existed, as firm as karst rock.
